articles.description: — Ryan Agarwal scored 17 points to guide Loyola Chicago to a 72-63 victory over San Jose State on Sunday night in the Acrisure Series.

articles.headline: Will Heimbrodt propels Seattle University to 90-64 romp over UC San Diego
articles.description: — Will Heimbrodt totaled 14 points and eight rebounds and Seattle University breezed to a 90-64 victory over UC San Diego on Sunday night in the Acrisure Series.

articles.headline: Jonah Hinton scores 23 to lead Rhode Island to 79-64 victory over UAB at Greenbrier Tip-Off
articles.description: — Jonah Hinton sank seven 3-pointers and scored 23 to lead Rhode Island to a 79-64 victory over UAB on Sunday at the Greenbrier Tip-Off.

articles.headline: Jacob Dar, Jaxson Thompson help Rice fend off Lamar 85-81 at Jacksonville Classic
articles.description: — Jacob Dar totaled 23 points and 11 rebounds and Jaxson Thompson scored 20 to help Rice hold off Lamar 85-81 on Sunday at the Jacksonville Classic.

articles.headline: Dominick Nelson scores 28 to help Utah Valley hold off UT Martin 78-76 in OT at Paradise Jam
articles.description: — Dominick Nelson scored 28 points and hit the go-ahead jumper in overtime to lead Utah Valley to a 78-76 victory over UT Martin on Sunday at the Paradise Jam.

articles.headline: Terry Coner Jr. scores 10 of his 34 points in OT to lead Cal Baptist over Portland 79-71
articles.description: — Terry Coner Jr. scored 34 points, including 10 in the overtime, and California Baptist defeated Portland 79-71 on Sunday in the Acrisure Series.
